endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (hudson_river_newcomb_indian_confluence polaris-bridge-hudson-hand-launch) on Hudson River; treat the agency parking/carry anchor as on/near-water evidence, but confirm the exact water entry and landing before launch.
